verdict.rationale: GitCafe is a Git forge, and its first-party docs cover the whole story. Repositories are created in GitCafe (docs-9), managed from the CLI (docs-10), used with any Git client over HTTPS or SSH (docs-1), and browsed in the web UI (docs-2). The docs also state you can read commit history, inspect single commits and see who last changed each line (docs-30). Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of repo creation and history browsing, and detailed docs on repo management operations such as settings and deletion.
